item.title: Investigating Things to Extend Knowledge - Linear Algebra
item.description: Drawing from 3Blue1Brown's 'Essence of Linear Algebra', this post explores matrix multiplication, determinants, inverse matrices, and rank through the lens of geometric transformations, documenting my personal insights into learning linear algebra.
